name: Masonry & Setts
description: Dressed granite for cobbled streets and the solid brick rowhouses that hold their heat.

name: Deep Mining
description: Timbered shafts and steam winches to sink mines into iron and coal seams.

name: Tailoring
description: Patterns for heavy leather greatcoats. Coated colonists lose heat far more slowly.

name: Coal-Gas Lighting
description: Gas lamps to light the streets. Homes near a lamp are happier, and the colony comes alive at dusk.

name: Bloomery Metallurgy
description: Coal-fired furnaces reduce ore to iron, and smiths turn iron into tools.

name: Pressure Piping
description: Riveted iron mains that carry the Steamforge's steam to workshops anywhere in the colony.

name: Copper Metallurgy
description: Mining and smelting the green copper seams. Copper carries current and never rusts.

name: Precision Machining
description: Steam-driven lathes that cut true cogs, the heart of every engine and every clock.

name: Glasshouse Horticulture
description: Steam-heated glass halls that grow fresh tomatoes through the depths of winter.

name: Steam Engines
description: Coal-fired boiler houses to raise steam in quantity, the machines that drink it, and safety valves for when they drink too much.

name: Steam Fire Brigade
description: A steam pump that throws water farther and faster than any bucket chain.

name: Steam Radiators
description: Cast-iron radiators in every room: steam-heated tenements need no firewood at all.

name: Galvanism
description: Steam-turned dynamos and copper conduits: a second kind of power for the colony.

name: Arc Smelting
description: A galvanic arc melts ore without coal and yields twice the metal.

name: Analytical Engines
description: Brass calculating engines driven by galvanic power. The Board's dearest wish.

name: Aeronautics
description: A mooring mast for the Company's airships: export your surplus for credit and order supplies from the south.

name: Steam Tramways
description: Iron rails and a steam tram depot. Citizens ride across town at three times walking pace.

name: Pneumatic Post
description: Brass tubes on the steam main shoot goods between depots, so anything delivered to one can be collected at all.

name: Clockwork Automata
description: Brass automatons that work without food or warmth. They need winding with coal, and they wear out in time.
